🚨 Health Alert:
 India reports its first case of HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus).
•Symptoms: Fever, cough, congestion, difficulty breathing.
•At Risk: Kids, elderly, and those with weak immunity.
•Prevention: Wash hands, wear masks, sanitize surfaces, and avoid close contact. https://t.co/N5wPmWlnhX
